subject: Post-call: approval stencil + purchase lane intro request
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Emily Zhang <emily.zhang@careify.com>, Rajiv Sharma <rajiv@careify.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 13:02:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap & requested approval stencil + next steps

Thanks again for taking the call earlier today — quick written recap and a couple of asks so we can keep momentum. Short summary:

- Objective: Explore Redwood Inference for summarization and clinical note generation for Careify's provider platform.
- Key decision criteria you called out: data residency, SOC2 + pen test evidence, per-session latency under 300ms for short transcripts, and predictable unit economics for production.
- Immediate blockers: legal/procurement intake + primary economic approver sign-off (timeline influenced by Q3 budget gate).

Requests / next steps we discussed (can you confirm):
1) Please share a simple org slice (names + titles) of the approval path for vendor onboarding — specifically who signs financially and who owns security attestation. A redacted org chart or quick roster is perfect.
2) Can you confirm the economic buyer? From the call it sounded like Rajiv is the owner for platform-level spend; confirm if final sign-off sits with CFO/Head of Ops.
3) Please introduce procurement and legal contacts (email) so we can send the baseline procurement template + SOC2 evidence pack.
4) Timing: you mentioned an internal procurement window the week of 6/7 — are we OK to target a 30-min intro with Rajiv + procurement that week?

Attachments: call-notes-20270525.txt (meeting bullets), baseline-procurement-template.pdf (procurement-friendly contract outline).

If helpful, I'll prepare a 1-page "approval stencil" showing the minimal artifacts legal/procurement typically require and a proposed mutual action plan with milestones. Would you like that by EOD tomorrow?

Appreciate it — Ben

--
Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | (415) 555-0134

From: Emily Zhang <emily.zhang@careify.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Rajiv Sharma <rajiv@careify.com>, procurement@careify.com
Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 14:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap & requested approval stencil + next steps

Thanks Ben — great write-up and aligned with our notes. Quick answers below and attaching a redacted org chart.

- Economic buyer: Rajiv Sharma (CTO) is the technical and spend owner for platform integrations. Final approval route for anything above $75k runs through our VP of Finance (Asha Mehta) and procurement. For deals under $75k Rajiv can approve.
- Security/legal: our security lead (Vikram Patel) will need SOC2 Type II and a pen-test summary. Legal will likely want a standard SLA addendum and data processing addendum (DPA).
- Procurement: procurement@careify.com is the intake mailbox — I've CC'd it here. Procurement usually requests our baseline contract + insurance certs and needs 5-7 business days to review.
- Timing: week of 6/7 looks workable for a short intro. Rajiv is available Tue 6/8 after 11am PT.

I've attached 'careify-orgchart-redacted.pdf' — it lists Rajiv, Vikram (Security), Asha (Finance) and procurement intake. I'll ask Vikram for any current evidence bundles we can share (SOC2 cert + summary).

Next: pls draft the approval stencil and the MAP and we'll route internally. Happy to include procurement + legal on the MAP review when you have a version.

Best,
Emily Zhang
Head of Product Operations
Careify Health
emily.zhang@careify.com | 617-555-9090

Attachment: careify-orgchart-redacted.pdf

Appreciate the quick turnaround and the org slice — that's perfect.

Action items on our side:
- I'll share a one-page approval stencil and a short mutual action plan (MAP) that maps milestones (SOW, security review, contract review, PO) to owners and target dates. Expect that by EOD tomorrow (5/26).
- I'll also attach a compressed SOC2 + security evidence summary pack (no raw reports) and the baseline-procurement-template.pdf so procurement has something to kick off review.

Ask from you: please confirm Rajiv's preferred calendar slot on 6/8 after 11am PT (or suggest an alternate). Also confirm that procurement@careify.com is the right intake for the baseline template. If Vikram can share a checklist for required artifacts that would speed legal review.

If procurement wants a DocuSign link for signature-ready docs, we can provide that as well.

Thanks — I'll send the MAP + stencil tomorrow.

Ben
